performance.verdict: Campaigns fully dark 13 days; organic holding but paid pipeline is severed.

findings.text: Meta spend has been $0 every day since Aug 6 — 13 consecutive zero-spend days, confirmed by series. Paid lead flow is completely severed.
28-day CPL was $24.88 on 44 leads, but the last 13 days produced 0 leads at $0 spend — the 28-day figure flatters a broken current state.
GHL shows 32 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments — intake pipeline is not converting contacts even before the paid shutdown.
GBP actions fell 55.1% (7d vs prior 7d) and ig_reach collapsed to 0–1 since Aug 16 — organic amplification also lost while paid is dark.
GA4 sessions rose 52.32% week-over-week despite zero paid spend; sc_clicks averaged ~14/day last 7 days — residual organic interest is real but unmonetised.

suggestions.text: Diagnose and resolve the Meta campaign shutdown — confirm budget exhaustion or manual pause; restore spend to $65/day immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 for 13 consecutive days (Aug 6–18), wiping all paid lead flow against a 28-day CPL baseline of $24.88. Hamza/Hamdan must confirm today whether the pause was manual, a budget cap hit, or a billing issue, and restore CROA || CBO to $65/day as the last confirmed working budget level. Success check: spend logs show >$60 on Aug 20 and at least 2 leads recorded by Aug 22. Re-check Aug 22.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 32 contacts, 0 opportunities created — flag to Andrew before paid volume returns or leads will arrive into a broken funnel.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL recorded 32 contacts in the 28-day window but produced 0 opportunities and 0 appointments, meaning no contacts are being converted to pipeline regardless of lead source. Flag this to Andrew immediately — if the intake workflow is broken before campaigns reactivate, incoming leads will be lost again. Success check: at least 1 opportunity created in GHL within 48 hours of campaigns resuming. Re-check Aug 22.

suggestions.text: Monitor GA4 organic sessions (currently +52.32% WoW) — if paid restores and sessions compound, consider SEO-to-form funnel optimisation next cycle.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions rose 52.32% week-over-week despite zero paid activity, suggesting organic search interest is building. This is directional only (JCL has known GA4 double-counting). No action this cycle — re-check Aug 22 to see if the trend holds once paid campaigns are restored and attribution is cleaner.
